title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: Conservative NS source present; report.tex:193–197 omits factor1.5 on BDF history term which code applies.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: CGNS zones with TRI/QUAD/BAR and adjacency; MIXED sections are not handled.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: Roe/Rusanov conservative residual and BCs present; historical binary/source revision remains qualified.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: Roe/Rusanov paths with reported per-case controls; low-Mach numerical dissipation remains.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: Characteristic farfield, slip and no-slip adiabatic wall source and boundary checks present.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: LSQ limited reconstruction and positivity fallback present; no independent smooth-order proof.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: Limiter/positivity source exists; transient limiter is frozen during inner iterations and fully refreshed target is not checked.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: Newtonian/Fourier source and tangential wall-force projection residual.cpp:481–531.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: Steady LU-SGS and target source exist; M200 inviscid Cd still varies over its final100 samples.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: BDF2 formula in source and St≈0.178 supported; strict ratio uses predictor-frozen limiter and historical binary is unbound.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: Root-only global mesh, METIS and neighbor halos; rank table compares prior np8 target-level variants with lower-rank runs.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
